strings.en:
{1c:10}That doubt gets stronger every day.
Was this world really saved?{1a}Sure, we stopped the spirit world and
the material world from fusing, and the
monsters are gone from the surface.
But now the whole world's nothing{1a}but war.{1a}{0c:2b55235158}All this year, the only news reaching this
town's been so grim you can't believe
your ears.{1a}Sure, the world was far from peaceful
before that burst of light too, but the
scale and the cruelty now are a whole
other thing.{1a}Lately, every letter from Lanz just
makes me feel sorry for us all. Are
people really such stupid creatures?{1a}{0c:5128}I never wanted to say this, but I can't
help thinking that 'New World' or
whatever might've been a little better
after all...{0c:2b5409fe}
